questions.question: Which of the following statements is correct?

options.text: If the constituents of the medium oscillate along the direction of wave propagation, we call the wave a transverse wave
Frequency of a wave is the number of oscillations of each constituent particle in the vibrating medium per minute
If the constituents of the medium oscillate perpendicular to the direction of wave propagation, we call the wave a longitudinal wave.
The minimum distance between two points in a wave having the same phase at a particular instant of time is called the wave length.

questions.solution:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Wavelength -**

 
 
• It is a measure of the distance between two equal peaks of a crest or trough.
 
• It is denoted by the Greek letter 'lambda' (λ). Its SI unit is a **'Meter'.**
 
• There is a relationship between the wavelength (λ), the velocity (v) of the wave, and the frequency (f) of a wave.
 
• **λ = v / f**
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Transverse Waves -

 
 
• The mechanical wave which, when transmitted, vibrates perpendicular to the direction of propagation of the particle of the medium, is called a transverse wave.
 
• Transverse waves can only be produced in solids.
 
• These waves cannot be produced inside liquids.
 
• It can be produced only on the surface of the liquid.
 
 
 
• Longitudinal Wave -
 
 
• If the particles of the medium oscillate back and forth at their mean position in the direction of propagation of the wave, then such waves produced are called longitudinal waves. Like sound waves.
 
• Longitudinal waves can be produced in all mediums (solids, liquids, gases).
 
• Sound waves in the air, earthquake waves, and spring waves are also longitudinal waves.​
 
 
 
• **Electromagnetic or mechanical wave -**
 
 
• Waves that do not require any medium for propagation.
 
• That is, these waves can also propagate in a vacuum.
 
 
 
• ** Mechanical Waves -**
 
 
• The disturbance produced by throwing bricks in the water of a calm river or pond is called a mechanical wave.
 
• For mechanical waves to propagate through a medium, it is necessary that the medium has the properties of elasticity or inertia.

questions.question:
**Sentences of a paragraph are given below in jumbled order. Arrange the sentences in the right order to form a meaningful and coherent paragraph.**

A. Though they had never ever heard Subha utter their names, they unfailingly recognized her footsteps as she came into their shed.

B. They even understood the precious moments between them as she loved and cuddled them, scolded them, and pleaded to them.

C. Subha did really have a close circle of friends and companions; they were Sarbasi and Panguli, the two cows living in their cow-shed.

D. They understood the silent, melancholy tune of her unspoken words during those moments, and the intensity of her expressions more easily than the spoken language of other humans.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **option 1) i.e., 'CADB'.**

• When arranging sentences, it is easier to order the first few; and then eliminate the options accordingly.
 
• The first sentence of a paragraph is usually independent and introduces a topic. The second one provides more information about it. 
 
• Here, **only C is independent** and introduce a topic related to a person named Subha and two cows.
 
• It should be followed by **A **which talks about the cows feelings for the central character. 
 
• So, **A** must come after** C**. Then **CA** is the correct order.
 
• This order is shown in** option 1, **which shows the full sequence as: **CADB**.
 
• **Thus, the correct sequence is: CADB**

**C.** Subha did really have a close circle of friends and companions; they were Sarbasi and Panguli, the two cows living in their cow-shed.

**A.** Though they had never ever heard Subha utter their names, they unfailingly recognized her footsteps as she came into their shed.

**D.** They understood the silent, melancholy tune of her unspoken words during those moments, and the intensity of her expressions more easily than the spoken language of other humans.

**B. **They even understood the precious moments between them as she loved and cuddled them, scolded them, and pleaded to them.
